title: Ma Da Đầm Sen: Lời Nguyền Tháng Bảy
style: Photorealistic live-action Vietnamese atmospheric mystery drama film set in a Northern Vietnamese lotus-pond village in the seventh lunar month; gritty grade with deep charcoal-black shadows, murky jade-green water, wet earth browns and pale lotus pinks, natural skin texture, subtle 35mm film grain.
lighting: Low-key cinematic mystery lighting: flickering amber oil-lamp, candle and incense light against cold cyan-green moonlight on black water and midnight-blue shade; daylight stays muted, hazy and desaturated.

narrator.voice: Vietnamese man about 45, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (giọng chuẩn Hà Nội Bắc Bộ, never Southern accent) with clear six tones, sharp resonant mid-baritone with crisp consonants, fluent late-night ghost-story delivery in one continuous breath, every word spoken once and clearly, no stutter, no repeated words

@Ngan.name: Ngân
@Ngan.anchor: Ngân, 26, young literature teacher from the city; slim, straight black hair tied low at the neck, calm determined eyes; cream short-sleeve blouse, dark-brown trousers, flat sandals, small cloth shoulder bag.
@Ngan.voice: woman of 26, strictly standard Hà Nội strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent) (never Southern accent), clear warm mezzo, steady but breathless with fear, speaking at a brisk, urgent, fast-clipped pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@Khoi.name: Khôi
@Khoi.anchor: Khôi, 19, Ngân's younger brother, university student home for summer; lanky, short tousled black hair, pale tired face; faded navy T-shirt, grey shorts, white plastic honeycomb sandals.
@Khoi.voice: young man of 19, strictly standard Hà Nội strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent) (never Southern accent), light tenor, shaky and breathless, speaking at a brisk, urgent, fast-clipped pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@BaHanh.name: Bà Hạnh
@BaHanh.anchor: Bà Hạnh, 74, their grandmother; small and stooped, silver hair in a low bun under a black velvet headband, deep-lined gentle face; brown Northern village blouse, black trousers, wooden prayer beads on her wrist.
@BaHanh.voice: old woman of 74, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), soft raspy voice trembling with worry, speaking at a brisk, urgent pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@OngLy.name: Ông Lý
@OngLy.anchor: Ông Lý, 72, the former village chief; tall and gaunt, slicked-back grey hair, hard narrow eyes; faded olive-green collared jacket over a white undershirt, dark trousers, carved wooden walking cane.
@OngLy.voice: man of 72, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), deep stern gravelly baritone, speaking at a brisk, clipped pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@CoTham.name: Thắm (vong)
@CoTham.anchor: the mysterious young woman of the lotus pond from thirty years ago: pale wet skin, long soaked black hair with lotus stems, dark sorrowful eyes; soaked plain white Northern village blouse and black trousers, barefoot.
@CoTham.voice: young woman's cold breathy whisper, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), faint watery echo, speaking at a brisk pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@ThamXua.name: Thắm (thuở sinh thời)
@ThamXua.anchor: Thắm when alive, a slim 19-year-old orphan village girl; long black hair in a single braid, frightened dark eyes; plain plain white Northern village blouse and black trousers, barefoot.
@ThamXua.voice: young woman of 19, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), clear trembling voice, pleading, speaking at a brisk, urgent pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

scenes.title: Đầm Sen Đầu Làng & Bóng Áo Trắng Lúc Chạng Vạng
scenes.time_label: 18:00 Chạng vạng đầu tháng bảy âm lịch (00:00–01:00)
scenes.location: Con đê đất nhỏ chạy dọc đầm sen mênh mông đầu làng Hạ Liên lúc chạng vạng.
scenes.axis: Axis along the earthen embankment path with the vast lotus pond on screen-left and the village gate ahead.
scenes.props: Wheeled suitcase, cloth shoulder bag, lotus leaves and pink lotus flowers, wet bare footprints on the dry path.
scenes.setting: Dusk in the seventh lunar month: a narrow earthen embankment path along a vast lotus pond at the edge of a Northern Vietnamese village, tall lotus leaves, a bamboo hedge and tiled roofs in the distance.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Làng Hạ Liên có đầm sen đẹp nhất vùng, nhưng cứ vào tháng bảy âm lịch, đầm lại đòi đúng một mạng người.
beats: High aerial view of a vast lotus pond at dusk, thousands of round lotus leaves rippling in a cold wind beside a small village of tiled roofs.
The drone glides low over the dark water between pink lotus flowers as the last orange light fades and mist rises from the surface.
The camera settles above a narrow earthen embankment path that runs along the pond toward the village gate.
clips.sfx: wind sweeping across lotus leaves, frogs croaking, a distant temple bell

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngân, cô giáo trẻ dạy ở thành phố, bỏ dở kỳ nghỉ hè để về quê vì bà nội gọi điện, giọng run như sắp khóc.
beats: Side-tracking view along the narrow earthen embankment path beside the vast lotus pond at dusk, tall lotus leaves swaying in the fading light with no person in the opening frames.
@Ngan enters the frame walking briskly along the embankment path pulling a small wheeled suitcase, glancing at the dark water as her free hand tightens on her cloth shoulder bag.
@Ngan slows her steps as a cold gust bends the tall lotus leaves toward the path.
clips.sfx: suitcase wheels rattling on dry earth, wind through lotus leaves

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Giữa đầm sen mịt mù sương, có một cô gái áo trắng đứng ngập nước đến ngang hông, im lìm nhìn về phía cô.
clips.camera: 85mm telephoto locked-off shot over the shoulder
beats: Wide view across the misty lotus pond at dusk, dense green lotus leaves swaying over dark water.
Far out in the middle of the lotus pond, @CoTham stands waist-deep in the dark water among tall lotus stems, her long wet black hair hanging over her face.
@CoTham stands motionless in the misty water far from the bank, facing toward the shore.
clips.sfx: a low wind, water lapping, the croaking of frogs suddenly stopping

clips.speaker: @Ngan
clips.line: Này em ơi, trời tối rồi, sao còn đứng giữa đầm thế kia? Lên bờ đi, nguy hiểm lắm!
beats: The narrow dirt embankment road beside the misty lotus pond at dusk, lotus leaves rustling in the breeze.
@Ngan stands on the dirt embankment beside her suitcase, cupping one hand to her mouth and calling out toward the middle of the pond.
@Ngan lowers her hand and peers anxiously across the darkening water.
clips.sfx: wind over the water, frogs silent, a faint ripple

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Chớp mắt một cái, bóng trắng biến mất, chỉ còn những vòng nước loang dần và một bông sen đang khép cánh lại.
clips.camera: 50mm slow rack focus from the face to the pond
beats: @Ngan stares out at the pond, her eyes widening.
The focus shifts past her shoulder to the empty spot among the lotus leaves where slow rings of ripples spread across the black water.
A single pink lotus flower slowly folds its petals closed as the ripples fade.
clips.sfx: faint water dripping, a soft hollow plop, then silence

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Và khi cô quay lại, trên con đường đất khô ráo phía trước, một hàng dấu chân trần ướt sũng đang dẫn thẳng về làng.
clips.camera: 28mm low-angle tracking shot along the path
beats: @Ngan turns back toward the embankment path ahead.
Low on the dry earthen path, a trail of wet bare footprints glistens in the dusk, leading away from the pond toward the village.
@Ngan grips her suitcase handle, staring down at the dark wet prints as the camera holds low on the path.
clips.sfx: a cold wind, water dripping from lotus leaves, quick shallow breathing

scenes.title: Bữa Cơm Tối & Lời Dặn Của Bà Hạnh
scenes.location: Căn nhà ngói ba gian của bà Hạnh, cửa mở nhìn ra sân gạch và đầm sen tối om.
scenes.axis: Axis from the ancestral altar through the open wooden doors to the brick yard and the black pond beyond.
scenes.props: Oil lamp, ancestral altar with incense, low wooden dining tray on a bamboo mat, rice bowls, prayer beads.
scenes.setting: Evening: inside Bà Hạnh's old three-room tiled house — a low wooden dining tray on a bamboo mat, an ancestral altar with incense and an oil lamp, wooden doors open to a brick yard and the black lotus pond beyond.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bà Hạnh ngoài bảy mươi, sống với đứa cháu trai út, và từ đầu tháng bảy, đêm nào bà cũng thắp hương ra phía đầm.
beats: Slow push-in toward the open wooden doorway of the old three-room tiled house at evening, warm amber oil-lamp light glowing against the dark brick yard.
In the dim doorway, @BaHanh holds a small oil lamp as @Ngan steps inside with her suitcase; @BaHanh takes @Ngan's hand and glances past her toward the dark pond.
@BaHanh turns to the ancestral altar, lifting three lit incense sticks toward the open door.
clips.sfx: crickets, the crackle of the oil lamp wick, a dog barking far away

clips.speaker: @BaHanh
clips.line: Con về là bà mừng rồi. Nhớ lời bà, tháng bảy này tối đến tuyệt đối không được bén mảng ra gần đầm sen.
beats: Over @Ngan's shoulder, @BaHanh speaks close to her granddaughter, the oil lamp lighting her deep-lined face.
@BaHanh squeezes @Ngan's wrist, her eyes darting toward the open door.
@BaHanh falls silent, her mouth closing, prayer beads still in her fingers.
clips.sfx: incense crackling, crickets, wind moving the wooden door

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Khôi, cậu em mười chín tuổi, cười xòa bảo bà lẩm cẩm, nhưng cả tuần nay đêm nào cậu cũng mơ thấy mình đang chìm.
clips.camera: 35mm wide static shot of the dining mat
beats: Wide static view of the woven bamboo mat and low wooden dining tray with steaming bowls under warm oil-lamp light inside the quiet old house.
The camera frames @Khoi sitting cross-legged at the low dining tray, grinning toward his sister off-frame as he scoops rice into his bowl with a slight tremor in his hand.
@Khoi's smile fades as he sets the chopsticks down and rubs the dark shadows under his eyes.
clips.sfx: chopsticks tapping bowls, crickets outside, a soft laugh

clips.speaker: @Khoi
clips.line: Chị đừng tin bà, chuyện ma da bắt người chỉ là chuyện người lớn dọa trẻ con cho khỏi đi tắm đầm thôi.
beats: Medium close-up of @Khoi talking with a lopsided grin, chopsticks in hand.
@Khoi shrugs, still talking, though his eyes flick toward the dark doorway behind his sister.
@Khoi looks down at his bowl, his grin gone.
clips.sfx: crickets, a moth tapping against the oil lamp

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngân để ý thấy cổ chân Khôi có một vệt bầm tím, hằn rõ như vết ngón tay ai đó vừa nắm chặt.
beats: Extreme close-up of @Khoi's bare ankle resting on the bamboo mat in the lamplight.
The camera slowly tilts along the ankle, revealing a dark purple bruise shaped like five long fingers wrapped around the skin.
A single drop of water falls from the ankle onto the mat.
clips.sfx: a slow drip, crickets, a sudden hush

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bà Hạnh nhìn vết bầm, mặt cắt không còn giọt máu, rồi lặng lẽ châm thêm ba nén hương hướng ra phía đầm sen.
clips.camera: 35mm slow pull-back from the altar to the open door
beats: Slow pull-back from the ancestral altar where incense smoke curls upward in the warm oil-lamp glow toward the open wooden doorway.
@BaHanh steps up to the altar with prayer beads in her fingers, lights three incense sticks with trembling hands and turns toward the open doorway.
The camera settles framing @BaHanh in the doorway as incense smoke drifts out toward the dark pond.
clips.sfx: incense crackle, wind, a distant splash from the pond

scenes.title: Tiếng Gọi Tên Lúc Nửa Đêm
scenes.location: Buồng sau có màn tuyn, sân gạch dưới trăng và mép đầm sen.
scenes.axis: Axis from the barred bedroom window across the moonlit yard to the edge of the black pond.
scenes.props: Mosquito-net bed, barred wooden window, moonlit brick yard, lotus leaves at the water's edge, floating black hair.
scenes.setting: Deep night: a back bedroom with a mosquito-net bed and a barred wooden window facing the lotus pond, a single blue shaft of moonlight.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Nửa đêm, Khôi choàng tỉnh vì nghe ngoài đầm có giọng con gái gọi tên mình, ngọt ngào và ướt át như vừa ngoi lên.
clips.camera: 35mm static medium shot through the mosquito net
beats: Static medium view of the dark back bedroom at night, a single shaft of cold blue moonlight falling through the barred wooden window onto the white mosquito net.
Through the white mosquito net, @Khoi lies on the bed; his eyes open suddenly and he lifts his head toward the barred window, listening.
@Khoi sits up slowly inside the mosquito net, his face turned toward the moonlit window.
clips.sfx: a faint distant girl's voice humming over water, crickets, the creak of the bed

clips.speaker: @CoTham
clips.line: Khôi ơi, dưới đầm mát lắm, xuống đây với em đi. Em đợi anh lâu lắm rồi, lạnh lắm Khôi ơi.
clips.camera: 85mm telephoto locked-off shot across the pond
beats: Telephoto view across the misty lotus pond under cold moonlight, silver ripples moving gently between dark lotus leaves with no person in the opening frames.
Among the tall lotus stems, @CoTham appears waist-deep in the water, lifting her pale face toward the house and whispering softly.
@CoTham extends one pale hand palm-up toward the shore as mist drifts past.
clips.sfx: water dripping, a breathy echoing whisper, frogs falling silent
clips.setting: Deep night: the black lotus pond under cold moonlight, mist drifting between the leaves.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Như bị ai giật dây, Khôi bước ra sân, chân trần lạnh ngắt, mắt mở trừng trừng mà không hề chớp lấy một lần.
beats: Handheld view of the moonlit brick yard outside the open wooden doorway of the old house, mist curling up from the lotus pond at the edge of the yard.
@Khoi steps barefoot out of the dark doorway into the moonlit brick yard, walking with slow stiff steps straight toward the pond.
@Khoi reaches the wet grass at the water's edge under the cold moonlight.
clips.sfx: bare feet on cold bricks, crickets, the whisper of lotus leaves
clips.setting: Deep night: the moonlit brick yard of the old house leading down to the edge of the black lotus pond, mist on the water.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngân tỉnh giấc vì tiếng cửa kẽo kẹt, cô lao ra kịp lúc nước đầm đã ngập đến đầu gối em trai mình.
clips.camera: 24mm wide shot from the water looking back at the shore
beats: Wide view from the misty lotus pond looking back toward the moonlit grassy bank and brick yard, round lotus leaves swaying on the dark water.
@Khoi stands knee-deep among the lotus leaves as @Ngan runs barefoot down the moonlit bank and splashes into the shallows behind him.
@Ngan wraps both arms around @Khoi's shoulders from behind, holding him steady in the shallow water.
clips.sfx: splashing water, rapid breathing, frogs croaking
clips.setting: Deep night: the moonlit brick yard of the old house leading down to the edge of the black lotus pond, mist on the water.

clips.speaker: @Ngan
clips.line: Khôi! Tỉnh lại đi em! Em đang làm cái gì thế này? Nhìn chị đây này, Khôi!
beats: Knee-deep in the water, @Ngan turns @Khoi around by the shoulders and shouts into his blank face.
@Ngan shakes @Khoi gently, her wet hair stuck to her cheeks.
@Khoi blinks once, slowly, his eyes coming back into focus.
clips.sfx: water sloshing, frogs, a cold wind
clips.setting: Deep night: the moonlit brick yard of the old house leading down to the edge of the black lotus pond, mist on the water.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Khôi chẳng nhớ gì cả, nhưng Ngân thì nhìn rõ, ngay chỗ em vừa đứng, mặt nước nổi lên một nắm tóc dài đen nhánh.
clips.camera: 35mm slow tilt down from the siblings to the water
beats: @Ngan guides @Khoi back onto the grassy bank, both of them soaked and shivering in the moonlight.
The camera tilts down to the dark water where they stood; long dark lotus stems and a strand of black hair drift across the ripples.
The ripples slowly settle across the dark surface of the pond.
clips.sfx: dripping water, chattering teeth, a low hollow gurgle
clips.setting: Deep night: the moonlit brick yard of the old house leading down to the edge of the black lotus pond, mist on the water.

scenes.title: Dấu Chân Ướt & Lá Sen Trên Gối
scenes.location: Buồng sau và sân gạch nhà bà Hạnh trong sương sớm, đầm sen mờ phía xa.
scenes.axis: Axis from the yard door along the brick floor to the mosquito-net bed.
scenes.props: Wet small footprints, wet lotus leaf on a pillow, strands of long black hair, stone water jar, coconut-husk brush.
scenes.setting: Grey early morning: the old house's back bedroom with a mosquito-net bed, its door open to the brick yard, mist lying on the lotus pond beyond.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Sáng hôm sau, từ mép đầm vào tận giường Khôi là một hàng dấu chân trần còn ướt, nhỏ nhắn như chân con gái.
clips.camera: 24mm low-angle slow dolly along the floor
beats: Low-angle dolly shot along the red-brick floor of the old house in grey early morning light, following a line of wet bare footprints leading in from the open yard door.
The camera follows the footprints across the bedroom floor as @Ngan walks beside them, looking down closely.
The footprints end beside the mosquito-net bed; @Ngan stops there and looks at the pillow.
clips.sfx: a rooster crowing far off, dripping water, soft footsteps

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trên gối của Khôi là một chiếc lá sen còn đẫm nước, cuống lá quấn mấy sợi tóc dài không phải của ai trong nhà.
beats: @Ngan lifts the edge of the mosquito net.
On the pillow lies a large wet lotus leaf, its stem wound with several strands of long black hair, water soaking into the cotton.
@Ngan's fingers hover above the leaf, trembling, without touching it.
clips.sfx: water seeping, a distant rooster, a held breath

clips.speaker: @BaHanh
clips.line: Nó chọn thằng Khôi rồi con ạ. Ba mươi năm nay, tháng bảy nào nó cũng về đòi đúng một người.
beats: Static view of the mosquito-net bed in grey morning light, a fresh wet green lotus leaf resting on the pillow beside the open window.
The camera frames @BaHanh standing beside @Ngan at the bed; @BaHanh looks at the lotus leaf and speaks to @Ngan in a hushed, trembling whisper.
@BaHanh sits slowly on the edge of the bed, her hands clasped together.
clips.sfx: a soft sob, morning birds, dripping water

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bà kể, người bị đầm bắt đi năm nào cũng là con cháu mấy nhà sống quanh bờ, và luôn đúng vào đêm rằm.
clips.camera: 35mm slow arc around the two women
beats: @Ngan sits beside @BaHanh on the bed edge, holding her grandmother's hands.
@BaHanh points a shaking finger toward the window and the misty pond beyond.
@Ngan turns her head to the window, jaw tightening.
clips.sfx: morning birds, wind on the window shutter

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Khôi ngồi bên chum nước kỳ cọ cổ chân đến rát đỏ, nhưng vết hằn đen sẫm ấy cứ loang dần như mực.
beats: Medium view of an old stone water jar and wooden dipper in the misty brick yard, grey morning mist drifting over the lotus pond beyond the gate.
@Khoi squats beside the stone water jar, scrubbing his ankle with a coconut-husk brush as water splashes onto the wet bricks.
@Khoi pauses, looking down at the dark mark on his ankle, breathing fast.
clips.sfx: water splashing, a brush scraping skin, roosters
clips.setting: Grey morning: a stone water jar in the brick yard of the old house, mist lying on the lotus pond beyond the gate.

clips.speaker: @Khoi
clips.line: Không phải mơ đâu chị ạ. Đêm qua em thấy rõ cô ấy nắm chân em, tay lạnh như đá.
beats: Close-up of @Khoi looking up from the water jar, water dripping from his hair.
@Khoi speaks in a low shaking voice, eyes red-rimmed.
@Khoi swallows hard and looks toward the misty pond.
clips.sfx: dripping water, a far-off cow bell
clips.setting: Grey morning: a stone water jar in the brick yard of the old house, mist lying on the lotus pond beyond the gate.

scenes.title: Ông Lý & Chuyện Ma Da Bắt Thế Mạng
scenes.time_label: 09:00 Sáng tại nhà ông Lý và đình làng (04:00–05:00)
scenes.location: Hiên nhà gạch cổ của ông Lý, sân đá, rặng tre, đầm sen phía sau; hậu cung đình làng.
scenes.axis: Axis from the stone courtyard up the porch steps to Ông Lý's carved chair, the pond behind the bamboo hedge.
scenes.props: Carved wooden chair, porcelain tea set, walking cane, forgotten incense bowl covered in cobwebs.
scenes.setting: Morning: the front porch of Ông Lý's large old brick house with a tiled roof, potted bonsai and a stone courtyard, the lotus pond visible behind a bamboo hedge.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Lý từng làm trưởng thôn hơn hai mươi năm, là người duy nhất trong làng chưa từng có con cháu bị đầm bắt.
beats: Low-angle view of the front porch of an old brick house with potted bonsai, a carved wooden table and steaming porcelain teapot in muted morning light.
The camera frames @OngLy sitting upright on a carved wooden chair on the porch, setting down his teacup and looking toward the pond with narrow eyes.
@OngLy turns his head toward the courtyard gate as footsteps approach.
clips.sfx: birdsong, the clink of a tea cup, a broom sweeping somewhere

clips.speaker: @OngLy
clips.line: Ma da thì phải tìm người thế mạng mới được đầu thai. Cô cứ làm mâm cúng, giữ thằng bé trong nhà là xong.
beats: View across the carved wooden tea table on the porch where steam rises from a small porcelain teapot, the bamboo hedge and lotus pond visible in the background.
Over @Ngan's shoulder, @OngLy speaks from his chair with a dismissive wave of his hand and pours tea without looking up.
@OngLy's fingers tighten around the porcelain teacup on the table.
clips.sfx: tea pouring, birds, wind in bamboo

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngân hỏi người chết đuối đầu tiên là ai, tay ông Lý khựng lại, nước trà sóng sánh tràn ra mặt bàn gỗ.
clips.camera: 100mm macro insert on the tea table
beats: Close view of a weathered wooden table on the porch in grey daylight, a ceramic teapot resting on the wood.
@OngLy's wrinkled hand sets a small porcelain teacup down hard on the table, amber tea sloshing over the rim.
@OngLy's fingers grip the teacup tightly as the spilled tea spreads across the dark wood.
clips.sfx: a sharp clink, tea dripping, a crow cawing

clips.speaker: @OngLy
clips.line: Chuyện từ đời nào rồi! Cô về nghỉ đi, đừng hỏi han chuyện cũ nữa!
beats: Close-up of @OngLy rising from his chair, face rigid, eyes avoiding the camera.
@OngLy speaks sharply, his jaw working, a vein standing out at his temple.
@OngLy turns away toward his front door, leaning on his cane.
clips.sfx: the chair scraping, wind in bamboo, a door creaking

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trên đường về, Ngân đi qua đình làng, thấy sau hậu cung có một bát hương nhỏ không tên, bị bỏ mặc phủ đầy mạng nhện.
clips.camera: 28mm slow push-in through the temple gate
beats: Slow push-in through the mossy stone gate of the old village communal temple in late morning light, red wooden pillars and quiet courtyard ahead.
@Ngan walks through the temple courtyard into the dusty back shrine room, stopping before a small forgotten incense bowl covered in cobwebs on a low shelf.
@Ngan reaches out and gently brushes the cobwebs from the incense bowl.
clips.sfx: temple wind chimes, pigeons cooing, dust settling
clips.setting: Late morning: the old village communal temple with red pillars and a tiled roof, its quiet back shrine room full of dust and cobwebs.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cụ thủ từ bảo, đó là bát hương của con bé Thắm mồ côi, người ba mươi năm trước bị cả làng gọi là kẻ trộm.
beats: @Ngan kneels before the cleaned incense bowl and lights a single incense stick.
Focus shifts from @Ngan's face to the thin smoke, which bends sideways and drifts toward the open temple door as if pulled by a draft.
@Ngan turns to follow the smoke with her eyes, toward the distant pond.
clips.sfx: incense hiss, wind chimes, a sudden cold gust
clips.setting: Late morning: the old village communal temple with red pillars and a tiled roof, its quiet back shrine room full of dust and cobwebs.

scenes.title: Mâm Cúng Bên Bờ Đầm & Những Ngọn Nến Tắt
scenes.location: Bờ cỏ của đầm sen về đêm, mâm cúng trên chiếu cói với vòng nến trắng.
scenes.axis: Axis from the offering tray on the bank straight out across the black water.
scenes.props: Offering tray with rice and boiled chicken, ring of white candles, white paper clothes, incense, flashlight.
scenes.setting: Night: the grassy bank of the lotus pond, a low offering tray on a straw mat with rice, boiled chicken, white paper clothes and a ring of white candles, black water beyond.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tối đó, bà Hạnh bày mâm cúng ngay bờ đầm, có cả bộ quần áo giấy trắng, khấn xin cho cháu mình được tha.
clips.camera: 24mm wide static shot from the water
beats: Wide view across the dark water toward the grassy bank at night, where a low offering tray with rice and a circle of lit white candles glows on a straw mat.
On the bank behind the ring of candles, @BaHanh kneels on the straw mat and bows three times with joined palms and lit incense sticks.
@BaHanh places a folded set of white paper clothes beside the water's edge.
clips.sfx: candle flames fluttering, crickets, frogs, a soft murmured prayer

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngân đứng sau lưng bà, tay cầm chiếc đèn pin, và cô đếm được mười hai ngọn nến đang cháy đều trong gió lặng.
beats: Slow push-in on the ring of lit white candles and incense sticks burning on the straw mat at the edge of the dark lotus pond at night.
The camera tilts up to frame @BaHanh kneeling in prayer with @Ngan standing behind her holding a flashlight, watching the candle flames.
@Ngan lifts her gaze from the candles toward the dark lotus pond.
clips.sfx: dead calm, a single cricket, candle wicks sizzling

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Rồi từng ngọn nến tắt phụt, lần lượt từ phía gần nước nhất, như có ai đang bước từ dưới đầm lên bờ.
clips.camera: 50mm low-angle close tracking shot along the candle ring
beats: Close on the ring of white candles on the dark grass, all burning steadily.
One by one, starting from the flame nearest the water, the candles snuff out with thin trails of smoke, the darkness moving up the bank.
Only the last candle beside the paper clothes still burns, its flame bending toward the pond.
clips.sfx: soft puffs of extinguished flames, water lapping, a wet footstep on grass

clips.speaker: @Ngan
clips.line: Bà ơi, đứng dậy đi bà! Có cái gì đang đi lên từ dưới nước kìa, mình vào nhà ngay đi bà!
beats: Handheld view of a bright flashlight beam sweeping across the dark lotus leaves and rippling water at the edge of the pond at night.
The camera frames @Ngan on the bank swinging the flashlight beam toward the water and calling out urgently as she steps back.
@Ngan stops still, holding the flashlight beam steady on the water's edge.
clips.sfx: rapid breathing, wet slapping steps on the grass, wind rising

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trong quầng đèn pin, bộ quần áo giấy trắng đã ướt sũng, đang từ từ đứng thẳng lên như có ai vừa mặc vào.
clips.camera: 35mm static wide shot in the flashlight beam
beats: Static wide view of the grassy water's edge in a flashlight beam at night, where soaked white paper clothes lie on the wet grass beside dark lotus leaves.
The white paper clothes stir in the cold wind at the bank as the faint pale figure of @CoTham appears standing quietly at the water's edge.
@CoTham stands motionless in the flickering flashlight beam beside the dark lotus leaves.
clips.sfx: wet paper rustling, water dripping, a long breathy sigh

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cùng lúc ấy, trong nhà, Khôi đang ngủ say bỗng cười khúc khích, tiếng cười trong trẻo của một cô gái lạ.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up through the mosquito net, slow push-in
beats: Inside the dark bedroom at night, cold cyan moonlight filtering through the wooden window bars onto the white mosquito net.
The camera pushes in slowly on @Khoi lying flat on his pillow fast asleep, his eyes tightly shut and his face pale.
@Khoi remains motionless with his eyes closed in sleep while the corner of his closed mouth forms a faint, eerie smile.
clips.sfx: a girl's clear echoing giggle, crickets stopping abruptly
clips.setting: Deep night: a back bedroom with a mosquito-net bed and a barred wooden window facing the lotus pond, a single blue shaft of moonlight.

scenes.title: Khôi Mất Tích Giữa Trưa
scenes.location: Đầm sen dưới nắng trưa trắng, đê đất, những chiếc thuyền thúng.
scenes.axis: Axis from the house gate down the embankment path out across the lotus pond.
scenes.props: White plastic sandals, bamboo basket boats, long bamboo poles, black lotus roots, silver lotus-bud hairpin.
scenes.setting: Hot hazy noon: the lotus pond under a white sky, a narrow embankment path, small round bamboo basket boats among the leaves.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trưa hôm sau, Ngân chỉ chợp mắt có nửa tiếng, tỉnh dậy đã không thấy Khôi đâu, đôi dép tổ ong nằm chỏng chơ ngoài cổng.
clips.camera: 28mm wide static shot at the gate
beats: Wide static view of the open wooden gate leading from the brick yard onto the earthen embankment path beside the sunlit lotus pond at hazy noon.
@Ngan hurries out through the gate into the noon glare and stops short beside a pair of white plastic sandals lying on the embankment path.
@Ngan looks up from the sandals toward the wide green lotus pond.
clips.sfx: cicadas buzzing, hot wind, footsteps stopping
clips.setting: Hot hazy noon: the gate of Bà Hạnh's house opening onto the embankment path beside the lotus pond.

clips.speaker: @Ngan
clips.line: Khôi ơi! Khôi! Em ở đâu thì trả lời chị một tiếng đi, chị xin em đấy Khôi ơi!
clips.camera: 50mm handheld medium shot tracking along the embankment
beats: Handheld tracking view along the narrow earthen embankment path beside the vast lotus pond at hazy noon, round bamboo basket boats floating in the distance.
@Ngan runs along the embankment path cupping her hands around her mouth and calling out across the pond.
@Ngan pauses on the path, breathing hard as she scans the dense lotus leaves.
clips.sfx: cicadas, an echoing voice over the water, ducks taking off

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cả xóm đổ ra, đàn ông chèo thuyền thúng, dùng sào tre khua khắp mặt đầm, nhưng chỉ vớt lên toàn rễ sen đen kịt.
clips.camera: 24mm high-angle crane shot over the pond
beats: High above the lotus pond, several round bamboo basket boats spread out across the water.
Village men in conical hats push long bamboo poles down through the lotus leaves, stirring up dark mud.
A pole lifts out of the water dripping with a tangle of black lotus roots.
clips.sfx: poles splashing, men calling to each other, cicadas
clips.extras: a few village men in conical hats paddling round bamboo basket boats, faces shaded, seen from above (unnamed)

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngân lội ra tận chỗ nước ngang ngực thì thấy giữa đám lá sen có một chiếc thuyền thúng cũ trôi lững lờ, không người chèo.
beats: Water-level tracking view moving through dense green lotus leaves and tall stems on the pond under a hazy white noon sky.
@Ngan wades chest-deep through the lotus leaves, pushing the stems aside with both arms as an old bamboo basket boat drifts ahead.
@Ngan reaches out and grips the woven rim of the bamboo basket boat.
clips.sfx: water sloshing, lotus leaves rustling, distant shouting

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Khôi nằm co quắp trong lòng thuyền, môi tím ngắt, người lạnh toát, tay nắm chặt một chiếc trâm bạc cũ.
clips.camera: 50mm top-down overhead shot into the boat
beats: Overhead view looking down at the round woven rim of a bamboo basket boat floating among green lotus leaves on the pond at noon.
Inside the boat, @Khoi lies curled on his side; @Ngan leans over the rim and touches @Khoi's cheek as he takes a steady breath.
The camera frames @Khoi's hand holding an old tarnished silver lotus-bud hairpin.
clips.sfx: water lapping the boat, a weak gasp, cicadas

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bà Hạnh nhận ra ngay chiếc trâm bạc ấy, kỷ vật của Thắm, cô gái mồ côi khuất bóng nơi đầm sen năm xưa.
beats: Macro close-up of a tarnished silver hairpin shaped like a lotus bud resting on a folded white cloth on a wooden table in soft afternoon light.
Focus racks up from the table to reveal @BaHanh leaning over the cloth, her eyes wide and one hand pressed to her chest.
@BaHanh lowers her gaze over the silver hairpin, tears glistening on her lined cheeks.
clips.sfx: a heavy silence, wind on the door, a soft sob
clips.setting: Late afternoon: inside the old house by the ancestral altar, soft grey light through the wooden doors.

scenes.title: Chuyện Năm Xưa Bà Hạnh Giấu Kín
scenes.location: Gian thờ nhà bà Hạnh dưới ánh đèn dầu, mưa đổ ngoài sân.
scenes.axis: Axis from the wooden chest under the altar toward the open door and the rain.
scenes.props: Wooden chest, faded black-and-white photograph, oil lamp, prayer beads, wet cloth.
scenes.setting: Night: inside the old house by the ancestral altar, an oil lamp on a low table, rain pouring outside the open door.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đêm đó, bà Hạnh mở rương gỗ dưới bàn thờ, lấy ra tấm ảnh cũ chụp ông nội Ngân cùng mấy người trong làng.
beats: Slow push-in on an old dark wooden chest beneath the ancestral altar inside the house at night, warm oil-lamp light flickering as rain falls outside.
@BaHanh kneels before the wooden chest with @Ngan beside her, lifts the lid and takes out a faded black-and-white photograph into the lamplight.
@BaHanh hands the old photograph to @Ngan in silence.
clips.sfx: rain on the tiles, the chest lid creaking, the lamp wick sputtering

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trong ảnh, ông Lý thời trẻ đứng giữa, tay cầm chùm chìa khóa hòm công đức của đình, ánh mắt sắc lạnh y như bây giờ.
beats: Close on the old black-and-white photograph in @Ngan's hands: a row of village men standing in front of a temple gate.
The camera slowly pushes in on the man in the center, younger but with the same hard narrow eyes, holding a ring of large keys.
@Ngan's thumb rests beside the man's face, trembling.
clips.sfx: rain on the roof, the lamp wick hissing

clips.speaker: @BaHanh
clips.line: Năm ấy hòm công đức mất sạch, ông Lý bảo chính mắt ông thấy con Thắm lẻn vào đình lúc nửa đêm.
beats: View of the flickering amber oil-lamp flame on the low wooden table inside the house at night, heavy rain pouring past the open doorway.
The camera frames @BaHanh across the table over @Ngan's shoulder as @BaHanh speaks softly, holding her wooden prayer beads.
@BaHanh lowers her eyes toward the table in the warm lamplight.
clips.sfx: rain growing heavier, thunder far away

clips.speaker: @BaHanh
clips.line: Cả làng đuổi theo nó ra tận bờ đầm. Ông nhà bà cũng cầm đuốc đứng đó, nhìn nó khuất dưới đầm mà không ai giúp.
beats: Close-up of @BaHanh, tears glistening on her lined face in the warm lamplight.
@BaHanh speaks in a hushed, emotional voice, her chin trembling.
@BaHanh presses both hands to her face, her shoulders trembling.
clips.sfx: heavy rain, a roll of thunder, a sob

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngân chợt hiểu, những người bị đầm bắt suốt ba mươi năm qua đều là con cháu của những kẻ đứng trên bờ đêm ấy.
clips.camera: 35mm slow pull-back toward the open door
beats: Slow pull-back from the low wooden table and flickering oil lamp toward the open doorway where night rain falls into the dark brick yard.
@Ngan sits quietly at the table holding the faded photograph in her lap, then turns her head toward the rain-swept doorway.
The camera pulls back through the doorway, framing @Ngan inside the lamplit room with the dark pond beyond.
clips.sfx: rain, thunder, a distant splash

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Còn Khôi, nằm sốt mê man trong buồng, cứ thì thào bằng giọng con gái rằng em không hề lấy trộm thứ gì.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up through the mosquito net, static
beats: Static view of the rain-streaked barred wooden window and white mosquito net in the dim bedroom at night, lit by a low oil lamp.
Through the mosquito net, @Khoi rests on the bed with a damp cloth on his forehead, turning his head restlessly on the pillow.
Drops of water glisten along the edge of the wooden bedframe in the dim lamplight.
clips.sfx: rain on the window, dripping water, a faint girl's whisper
clips.setting: Night: the back bedroom, mosquito-net bed, rain streaming down the barred window, a dim oil lamp.

scenes.title: Đêm Mưa Ba Mươi Năm Trước
scenes.time_label: Hồi tưởng — đêm mưa tháng bảy ba mươi năm trước (08:00–09:00)
scenes.location: Đầm sen và bờ đê lầy lội trong mưa lớn, chỉ có ánh đuốc (hồi tưởng, màu bạc).
scenes.axis: Axis along the muddy embankment toward the edge of the pond, torches behind.
scenes.props: Flaming torches, muddy embankment, black water, lotus leaves, burned-out torch stubs.
scenes.setting: Flashback, thirty years earlier, a stormy night in the seventh lunar month: the same lotus pond and muddy embankment in heavy rain, lit only by flaming torches; desaturated and grainy.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ba mươi năm trước, cũng một đêm mưa tháng bảy, Thắm chạy trối chết dọc bờ đầm, phía sau là cả một rừng đuốc.
beats: Handheld tracking view along a rain-swept muddy embankment beside the lotus pond on a stormy night, distant orange torchlight reflecting on wet mud.
@ThamXua runs barefoot through the rain along the muddy embankment, her braided hair swinging as she glances back toward the distant torches.
@ThamXua steadies herself on the wet bank beside the dark lotus leaves, breathing fast.
clips.sfx: pouring rain, thunder, distant angry shouting, splashing footsteps
clips.extras: a crowd of village men holding flaming torches far behind her, blurred silhouettes in the rain (unnamed)

clips.speaker: @ThamXua
clips.line: Cháu không lấy! Cháu thề có trời đất, cháu không hề động vào hòm công đức của đình!
clips.camera: 50mm medium close-up lit by off-frame torchlight
beats: Rain-swept muddy embankment beside the lotus pond at night, orange torchlight reflecting on wet mud and lotus leaves.
@ThamXua kneels on the wet mud in the pouring rain, her hands clasped in front of her chest as she pleads.
@ThamXua looks up through the rain with tears mixing with rainwater on her pale face.
clips.sfx: rain, thunder, crackling torches, angry murmuring

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Không ai tin cô. Người ta dồn cô ra sát mép nước, và người hô to nhất chính là ông Lý thời trẻ.
beats: Low angle through the rain: a wall of flaming torches held by blurred villagers on the muddy bank.
At the front, a gaunt man in an olive-green jacket thrusts his torch toward the pond, his face hard in the firelight.
The torchlight flickers across the black pond surface ahead of the crowd.
clips.sfx: pouring rain, crackling torches, a harsh distant shout, thunder
clips.extras: the younger Ông Lý, about 42, gaunt with hard narrow eyes, in an olive-green jacket, at the front of a crowd of blurred torch-bearing villagers (no reference image)

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Thắm lùi thêm một bước trên bờ đất ướt, tà áo trắng khuất dần sau những tàu lá sen đen sẫm trong màn mưa.
clips.camera: 35mm static wide shot from the water
beats: Wide view from the rain-swept lotus pond looking toward the muddy bank at night, orange torchlight flickering across the wet grass.
A single solitary figure, @ThamXua alone on the muddy bank, steps backward in the rain as tall lotus stems and mist surround her.
Raindrops and spreading ripples rock the dark lotus leaves across the water.
clips.sfx: pouring rain, wind rustling lotus leaves, distant voices falling silent

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cô vùng vẫy, một bàn tay nhô lên khỏi mặt nước như cầu cứu, nhưng hàng chục ngọn đuốc trên bờ không ai nhúc nhích.
beats: Water-level view in the falling rain as dark lotus leaves and a pale lotus bud rock on the ripples of the pond.
Beyond the swaying lotus stems, warm orange torchlight reflects across the wet muddy bank in the rain.
Concentric ripples slowly widen across the dark water surface under the rain.
clips.sfx: rain on the water, a muffled gasp, then only rain
clips.extras: blurred torch-bearing villagers standing still on the bank, out of focus (unnamed)

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Sáng hôm sau, không thấy hòm tiền, cũng chẳng thấy bóng Thắm đâu, cả làng bảo nhau rằng đầm sen đã giữ người ở lại.
beats: Grey dawn over the still lotus pond after the storm, mist drifting on the water.
On the muddy bank, burned-out torch stubs lie smoking among footprints.
The camera rises slowly, the pond silent and empty under the grey sky.
clips.sfx: dripping leaves, a lone crow, wind
clips.setting: Flashback dawn after the storm: the still lotus pond under a grey sky, mist on the water, torch stubs smoking in the mud; desaturated and grainy.

scenes.title: Đêm Rằm Tháng Bảy — Đầm Sen Gọi Khôi
scenes.location: Buồng sau dưới ánh trăng rằm, sân gạch, bờ đầm và đáy đầm sen.
scenes.axis: Axis from the moonlit bedroom out through the yard into the pond and down to its muddy bed.
scenes.props: Silver lotus-bud hairpin, full moon, lotus roots, old brass betel box engraved with a crane.
scenes.setting: Night of the seventh-month full moon: the lotus pond under a huge pale moon, mist on the water, Bà Hạnh's yard and gate at the edge.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đêm rằm tháng bảy, trăng tròn vằng vặc, Khôi bỗng hết sốt, ngồi dậy chải đầu bằng chiếc trâm bạc như một cô gái.
beats: Inside the moonlit bedroom at night, a white mosquito net hanging over the wooden bed beside the barred window.
@Khoi sits upright on the edge of the wooden bed in a trance, holding a small antique silver hairpin in his hand and slowly combing his hair.
@Khoi stares blankly toward the moonlit window with the silver hairpin in his hand.
clips.sfx: crickets stopping, a slow scrape of metal through hair, distant water
clips.setting: Night of the full moon: the back bedroom, moonlight pouring through the barred window onto the mosquito-net bed.

clips.speaker: @Khoi
clips.line: Chị ơi, cô ấy bảo đêm nay là đêm cuối cùng rồi. Em phải xuống trả lại cho cô ấy.
beats: View from the bedroom doorway looking toward the barred window and moonlit bed, silver moonlight reflecting on the brick floor.
Over @Ngan's shoulder in the doorway, @Khoi looks up from the moonlit bed with the silver hairpin in his hand and speaks in a calm, distant voice.
@Khoi rises slowly from the edge of the bed in the moonlight.
clips.sfx: crickets, wind, a faint watery hum
clips.setting: Night of the full moon: the back bedroom, moonlight pouring through the barred window onto the mosquito-net bed.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Khôi đi thẳng ra đầm, Ngân giữ thế nào cũng không lại, người cậu nặng trịch và lạnh như một khúc gỗ ngâm nước.
clips.camera: 24mm wide tracking shot from the side
beats: Wide side-tracking view across the moonlit brick yard leading down to the misty bank of the lotus pond under a full moon.
@Khoi walks steadily across the moonlit yard toward the pond while @Ngan holds onto his arm with both hands, trying to pull him back.
@Khoi steps into the shallow water at the bank as @Ngan stops at the edge.
clips.sfx: heels scraping grass, splashing, crickets, wind
clips.setting: Night of the full moon: the moonlit brick yard and the bank of the lotus pond, mist on the water.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Không kịp nghĩ ngợi, Ngân hít một hơi thật sâu rồi lội xuống làn nước đêm, nơi em trai cô vừa khuất bóng.
clips.camera: 35mm static medium shot at the water's edge
beats: @Ngan stands at the edge of the pond staring at the spreading rings on the moonlit water.
@Ngan takes a deep breath and wades forward into the deep water among the lotus leaves.
Moonlit ripples rock the lotus leaves across the surface of the pond.
clips.sfx: a deep inhale, a splash, then muffled silence
clips.setting: Night of the full moon: the moonlit brick yard and the bank of the lotus pond, mist on the water.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Dưới đáy đầm, giữa rừng rễ sen chằng chịt, Thắm đứng đó, tóc xõa bồng bềnh, lặng lẽ chỉ tay xuống lớp bùn.
beats: Slow underwater drift through murky green-black water at the bottom of the lotus pond, pale moonlight filtering between tall lotus stems and roots.
Among the tangled lotus roots underwater, @CoTham stands quietly in the dark water, her long black hair floating around her pale face.
@CoTham slowly extends one arm and points downward toward the soft mud at the bottom of the pond.
clips.sfx: muffled underwater rumble, bubbles, a low distant hum
clips.setting: Underwater at the bottom of the lotus pond: murky green-black water, a forest of lotus stems and roots, shafts of moonlight from above, drifting silt.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngân thọc tay xuống bùn, chạm phải một chiếc hộp kim loại lạnh ngắt, quấn chặt trong rễ sen và những sợi tóc dài.
beats: Soft dark mud and tangled lotus roots at the bottom of the pond underwater, drifting silt in the pale moonlight.
@Ngan pulls out an old brass box wrapped in lotus roots and long black hair, a crane engraved on its tarnished lid.
@Ngan clutches the box to her chest and swims upward hard toward the moonlight.
clips.sfx: muffled underwater sounds, a metallic scrape, bubbles rushing
clips.setting: Underwater at the bottom of the lotus pond: murky green-black water, a forest of lotus stems and roots, shafts of moonlight from above, drifting silt.

scenes.title: Chiếc Hộp Trầu Đồng Khắc Hình Hạc
scenes.location: Bờ đầm lầy lội dưới trăng, rồi sân nhà ông Lý lúc rạng sáng.
scenes.axis: Axis from the muddy bank of the pond to Ông Lý's porch steps at dawn.
scenes.props: Old brass betel box engraved with a crane, old silver coins in rotted red cloth, silver lotus-bud hairpin, walking cane.
scenes.setting: Night of the full moon: the muddy bank of the lotus pond, moonlight and mist.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngân ngoi lên, thấy Khôi đã nằm sẵn trên bờ, ho sặc sụa nhưng còn sống, như có ai vừa đặt cậu lên đó.
clips.camera: 28mm wide static shot from the water
beats: Wide view from the moonlit lotus pond looking toward the muddy grass bank at night, silver ripples spreading across the water.
@Ngan surfaces from the water holding a tarnished brass box to her chest while @Khoi rests safely on the muddy bank, breathing steadily.
@Ngan wades ashore and kneels beside @Khoi on the bank, resting one hand on his shoulder.
clips.sfx: gasping, coughing, water dripping, frogs

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bên trong hộp trầu là những đồng bạc trắng của đình làng, và nắp hộp khắc hình con hạc, vật gia truyền nhà ông Lý.
beats: Close on @Ngan's muddy hands prying open the tarnished brass box on the wet grass.
Inside, old silver coins glint in the moonlight, packed in faded old red cloth.
The camera tilts to the lid, where an engraved crane catches the moonlight.
clips.sfx: a rusty hinge creak, coins clinking, frogs

clips.speaker: @Ngan
clips.line: Ông nhìn kỹ đi! Hộp trầu nhà ông, tiền công đức của đình, nằm dưới đáy đầm ba mươi năm nay đấy!
beats: Static medium view of the stone courtyard and front porch of the old brick house at grey dawn, morning mist drifting over the bamboo hedge.
In the courtyard, @Ngan holds the tarnished brass box out toward @OngLy on his porch and speaks firmly.
@OngLy looks down at the brass box, his face pale and rigid.
clips.sfx: roosters, wind in bamboo, dripping water
clips.setting: Grey dawn: the stone courtyard and front porch of Ông Lý's old brick house, mist from the pond drifting over the bamboo hedge.

clips.speaker: @OngLy
clips.line: Láo toét! Hộp trầu thì nhà nào chẳng có. Cô dám vu cho tôi thì cả làng này sẽ không tha cho cô đâu!
beats: Close-up of @OngLy shouting, his narrow eyes blazing.
@OngLy jabs his cane toward the courtyard gate, his hand shaking.
@OngLy's gaze drops to the brass box and he swallows hard.
clips.sfx: roosters, wind, the cane tapping stone
clips.setting: Grey dawn: the stone courtyard and front porch of Ông Lý's old brick house, mist from the pond drifting over the bamboo hedge.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngân không cãi. Cô chỉ đặt chiếc trâm bạc của Thắm lên bậc thềm nhà ông, rồi lặng lẽ bỏ về.
clips.camera: 50mm low-angle shot on the porch steps
beats: Low-angle view of the weathered stone steps of the front porch at grey dawn, damp mist clinging to the stones.
@Ngan steps up, kneels by the stone porch steps and places the tarnished silver lotus hairpin on the top step before rising and turning away.
The camera holds low on the silver hairpin resting on the stone step.
clips.sfx: footsteps on stone, roosters, a cold breeze
clips.setting: Grey dawn: the stone courtyard and front porch of Ông Lý's old brick house, mist from the pond drifting over the bamboo hedge.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Lý đứng nhìn chiếc trâm rất lâu. Ba mươi năm rồi, lần đầu tiên ông thấy bàn tay mình run lên không dừng được.
beats: Close view of the tarnished silver lotus hairpin resting on the stone porch step in the cold grey dawn light.
The camera tilts up to @OngLy standing on the porch looking down at the hairpin, his weathered hands trembling on the head of his walking cane.
@OngLy closes his eyes, his jaw tight.
clips.sfx: wind in bamboo, a distant temple bell, ragged breathing
clips.setting: Grey dawn: the stone courtyard and front porch of Ông Lý's old brick house, mist from the pond drifting over the bamboo hedge.

scenes.title: Đêm Ông Lý Bị Gọi Tên
scenes.location: Buồng ngủ tối của ông Lý với giường gỗ chạm, cửa sổ nhìn ra đầm.
scenes.axis: Axis from the window facing the pond across the brick floor to the foot of the carved bed.
scenes.props: Carved wooden bed, oil lamp, wet footprints on the brick floor, walking cane.
scenes.setting: Night: Ông Lý's dark bedroom with a heavy carved wooden bed, a tall cabinet and a window facing the lotus pond, a single oil lamp turned low.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đêm ấy, ông Lý nghe ngoài đầm có tiếng con gái gọi đúng tên cúng cơm của ông, cái tên chẳng ai còn nhớ.
beats: Static medium view of a dark bedroom at night with a carved wooden bed, a tall wooden cabinet and a dim oil lamp flickering near the window.
On the carved wooden bed, @OngLy lies awake; his eyes turn toward the window and he props himself up on one elbow, listening.
@OngLy sits up on the edge of the bed, looking toward the moonlit window.
clips.sfx: a faint girl's voice calling from far over water, crickets, the bed creaking

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Từ cửa sổ vào tận đầu giường, những vệt nước loang dần trên nền gạch, kéo theo mùi bùn tanh lạnh của đáy đầm.
beats: Rain-streaked wooden window and dark brick floor of the old bedroom at night, a thin trail of water glistening on the tiles.
@OngLy sits on the edge of his wooden bed in the dim oil-lamp light, looking down in shock at the wet trail on the floor.
@OngLy grips his wooden cane with trembling hands as the oil lamp flickers.
clips.sfx: slow wet footsteps, dripping water, the lamp flame sputtering

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Lý ngẩng đầu lên, thấy Thắm đang đứng lặng ngay cuối giường, đôi mắt buồn rượi nhìn ông không lời oán trách.
beats: View across the dark bedroom floor where wet footprints glisten in the dim oil-lamp light near the foot of the carved wooden bed.
The camera tilts up over @OngLy's shoulder to reveal @CoTham standing quietly at the foot of the bed, looking at him with calm, sorrowful eyes.
@OngLy leans back against the wooden headboard, gripping the blanket.
clips.sfx: steady dripping, the lamp hissing, ragged breathing

clips.speaker: @OngLy
clips.line: Là tao lấy, Thắm ạ! Tao sợ quá nên mới đổ tội cho mày. Tao xin mày, tha cho tao!
clips.camera: 85mm close-up with a slight Dutch angle, static
beats: Close-up of @OngLy pressed against the headboard, his face wet with tears and sweat.
@OngLy pleads with his palms pressed together, his voice breaking.
@OngLy bows his head down onto his joined hands, sobbing.
clips.sfx: sobbing, dripping water, wind rattling the shutters

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Thắm không nói gì. Cô chỉ quay đi, để lại trên nền gạch một vũng nước nhỏ, phản chiếu ánh đèn dầu leo lét.
beats: Wide static view of the moonlit wooden window and dim oil lamp inside the quiet bedroom at night.
@CoTham turns from the bed and walks slowly toward the moonlit window, her figure fading softly into the shadow beside the frame.
A small puddle of water on the brick floor reflects the flickering oil-lamp flame.
clips.sfx: soft wet footsteps fading, the lamp hissing, crickets returning

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Gà gáy canh tư, ông Lý vẫn ngồi đó, lần đầu tiên sau ba mươi năm, ông quyết định sẽ nói ra sự thật.
beats: Slow push-in on the bedroom window as cold blue pre-dawn light fills the room and the oil lamp on the table stands unlit.
On the edge of the carved bed, @OngLy sits hunched in the blue dawn light, then straightens his back and wipes his face with both hands.
@OngLy takes hold of his wooden walking cane and stands up.
clips.sfx: a rooster crowing, a cold wind, the cane tapping the floor
clips.setting: Pre-dawn: Ông Lý's bedroom in cold blue light through the window, the oil lamp burned out.

scenes.title: Lời Thú Tội Trước Sân Đình
scenes.time_label: 08:00 Sáng hôm sau tại đình làng (12:00–13:00)
scenes.location: Sân đình làng lát đá với cột đỏ, dân làng tụ tập phía sau.
scenes.axis: Axis from the temple drum across the stone courtyard to the small incense bowl on a table.
scenes.props: Temple drum, small incense bowl, stone courtyard, prayer beads, carved name tablet.
scenes.setting: Morning: the stone courtyard of the old village temple with red pillars and a tiled roof, villagers gathered as blurred figures in the background, soft grey sky.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Sáng hôm ấy, ông Lý gõ trống đình, gọi cả làng ra sân, đứng trước bát hương không tên của Thắm mà quỳ xuống.
clips.camera: 28mm wide static shot of the temple courtyard
beats: Wide static view of the stone courtyard of the old village temple in soft morning mist, red wooden pillars and a large wooden drum on a stand.
@OngLy steps up to the wooden temple drum and beats it with a padded stick as blurred villagers gather in the courtyard, then walks to the small incense bowl.
@OngLy kneels slowly on the stone courtyard before the small incense bowl.
clips.sfx: deep drum beats echoing, murmuring villagers, birds
clips.extras: villagers gathering in the background, blurred and out of focus (unnamed)

clips.speaker: @OngLy
clips.line: Ba mươi năm trước, chính tôi lấy tiền công đức rồi đổ tội cho con Thắm. Nó chịu oan khuất vì tôi.
beats: Close-up of @OngLy kneeling, his face grey and wet, looking up toward the off-frame crowd.
@OngLy speaks loudly and clearly, his voice shaking but steady.
@OngLy lowers his forehead to the stone courtyard.
clips.sfx: a stunned hush, wind chimes, a single gasp

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bà Hạnh bật khóc. Chồng bà và bao người khác đã chọn im lặng đêm ấy, để rồi con cháu phải trả giá.
beats: Slow push-in across the misty stone courtyard of the village temple where incense smoke rises before the red wooden pillars.
Among the blurred villagers, @BaHanh presses both hands to her mouth, then kneels down on the stone courtyard with tears on her cheeks.
@BaHanh bows her head toward the incense bowl, wooden prayer beads in her joined hands.
clips.sfx: sobbing, murmuring, wind chimes
clips.extras: villagers in the background, blurred and out of focus (unnamed)

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngân siết chặt tay em trai. Vết hằn lạnh buốt nơi cổ chân Khôi, từ sáng hôm ấy, đã nhạt dần như chưa từng có.
beats: Stone courtyard of the village communal temple in soft morning light, red wooden pillars and warm incense smoke in the background.
@Ngan and @Khoi stand side by side in the courtyard in full view from head to toe, @Ngan holding @Khoi's hand as he looks down at his clean, healed ankle.
@Ngan and @Khoi look at each other in quiet relief as morning sunlight warms the courtyard.
clips.sfx: wind chimes, a soft exhale, distant birds

clips.speaker: @Khoi
clips.line: Chị ơi, em không còn nghe thấy tiếng cô ấy gọi nữa. Lần đầu tiên sau mấy tuần, em thấy ấm người.
beats: Over @Ngan's shoulder, @Khoi turns to her and speaks quietly, a tired smile on his face.
@Khoi's eyes glisten as he talks, color returning to his cheeks.
@Ngan pulls @Khoi into a brief hug.
clips.sfx: wind chimes, birds, soft murmurs of the crowd

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngay tối hôm ấy, cả làng lập đàn cầu siêu cho Thắm, và bát hương không tên cuối cùng đã có chủ.
clips.camera: 100mm macro insert, slow push-in on the incense bowl
beats: Close on the small incense bowl, now cleaned, sitting on new red cloth beside fresh pink lotus flowers.
Three new incense sticks burn straight upward, their smoke rising in still air.
A carved wooden name tablet stands behind the bowl, seen from the side so no writing is visible.
clips.sfx: incense crackling, distant chanting, wind chimes
clips.setting: Late afternoon: the temple's back shrine room, the small incense bowl now cleaned, red cloth beneath it and fresh lotus flowers beside it.

scenes.title: Lễ Cầu Siêu & Đèn Hoa Đăng Trên Mặt Đầm
scenes.location: Bờ đầm sen về đêm với hàng trăm đèn hoa đăng trôi trên mặt nước, ban thờ nhỏ bên bờ.
scenes.axis: Axis from the small altar on the bank out across the lantern-covered water.
scenes.props: Paper lotus lanterns, small altar with incense, silver lotus-bud hairpin, walking cane.
scenes.setting: Night: the bank of the lotus pond lit by hundreds of small paper lotus lanterns floating on the black water, a simple altar with incense on the bank, villagers as distant blurred silhouettes.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đêm ấy, hàng trăm ngọn đèn hoa đăng được thả xuống đầm sen, ánh lửa nhỏ lấp lánh trải dài như một dải ngân hà.
beats: Aerial view of the black lotus pond at night, hundreds of small glowing paper lotus lanterns drifting across the water.
The drone glides low over the lanterns, their warm light flickering between the dark lotus leaves.
The camera settles over the bank where tiny silhouettes kneel before a small altar.
clips.sfx: soft chanting, water lapping, a gentle wind
clips.extras: villagers on the bank as tiny distant silhouettes (unnamed)

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bà Hạnh run run thả chiếc đèn cuối cùng, trên đó bà tự tay đặt chiếc trâm bạc, trả lại cho người con gái năm xưa.
beats: Water-level view of glowing paper lotus lanterns floating on the dark pond at night beside the grassy bank.
At the water's edge, @BaHanh kneels with @Ngan beside her, placing the silver hairpin inside a paper lotus lantern and setting it gently on the water.
The glowing lantern drifts out across the pond as @Ngan puts a comforting arm around @BaHanh's shoulders.
clips.sfx: water lapping, soft chanting, a gentle breeze

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Giữa đầm, Thắm hiện lên lần cuối, không còn ướt sũng, áo trắng khô ráo, mái tóc tết gọn gàng như ngày còn sống.
clips.camera: 85mm telephoto slow push-in across the lanterns
beats: Telephoto slow push-in across dozens of warm glowing paper lotus lanterns drifting on the calm black water of the pond at night.
Between the floating lanterns across the water, @ThamXua appears standing dry and calm in clean white clothes, her hair neatly braided, looking toward the bank.
@ThamXua lowers her head in a slow, peaceful bow under the warm lantern light.
clips.sfx: soft chanting, water lapping, a faint wind chime

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Khôi đứng trên bờ, chắp tay vái theo. Cậu biết, chiếc đèn có trâm bạc kia vừa dừng lại ngay trước mặt cô gái.
beats: Static medium view of the grassy pond bank at night, warm golden light from floating paper lanterns reflecting on the water.
On the bank, @Khoi steps forward with joined palms and bows three times toward the lantern-lit pond.
@Khoi lifts his head, his eyes shining in the warm lantern light as he watches the water.
clips.sfx: chanting, lapping water, crickets

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bóng cô gái mờ dần rồi tan vào ánh đèn, và lần đầu tiên sau ba mươi năm, cả đầm sen nở bung giữa đêm trăng.
beats: Close on a cluster of closed lotus buds among the floating lanterns.
One after another, the lotus buds slowly open into full pink blooms in the lantern light.
The camera pulls back to reveal the whole pond blooming under the moon.
clips.sfx: a soft rustle of opening petals, distant chanting, wind

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Lý đứng tách khỏi đám đông, xin được dựng một tấm bia đá nhỏ bên bờ đầm, để làng đời đời nhớ cái tên Thắm.
beats: Medium view of the quiet pond bank at night where hundreds of paper lanterns glow across the dark water in the background.
@OngLy stands near the edge of the bank leaning on his cane as @Ngan walks up beside him; @OngLy lifts his head and gives her a slow nod.
@Ngan nods once in return, and both look out across the drifting lanterns.
clips.sfx: chanting, water lapping, crickets

scenes.title: Mùa Sen Năm Sau & Bóng Người Thứ Hai
scenes.time_label: Một năm sau — sáng đến đêm (14:00–15:00)
scenes.location: Đầm sen nở rộ một năm sau, tấm bia đá nhỏ bên bờ, bến xe đầu làng.
scenes.axis: Axis from the small stone stele on the bank across the blooming pond to its far shadowed corner.
scenes.props: Small stone stele seen from behind, incense, broom, suitcase, bus stop.
scenes.setting: Bright misty morning a year later: the lotus pond in full bloom, a small new stone stele with incense on the bank, the village road beyond.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Một năm sau, đầm sen làng Hạ Liên nở rộ chưa từng thấy, và tháng bảy năm ấy không còn ai bị gọi tên nữa.
beats: Aerial view of the vast lotus pond in full pink bloom under a soft morning mist.
The drone glides forward over the flowers toward a small new stone stele on the bank, incense smoke rising.
The camera settles on the stele, seen from behind so no writing is visible, fresh lotus flowers at its base.
clips.sfx: morning birds, gentle wind over lotus leaves, a distant temple bell

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngân về thăm bà, mang theo bó hương thắp cho Thắm. Bà Hạnh giờ đã khỏe, sáng nào cũng ra bờ đầm quét lá.
beats: Morning mist drifting over the blooming pink lotus pond beside a small stone memorial stele on the grassy bank.
Only two people, @Ngan and her grandmother @BaHanh, stand side by side before the stone stele as @Ngan places glowing incense sticks in the censer.
@BaHanh and @Ngan bow their heads quietly together beside the sunny lotus pond.
clips.sfx: birds, a broom sweeping, gentle wind

clips.speaker: @Khoi
clips.line: Chị thấy không, năm nay ai cũng bảo đầm sen đẹp nhất từ trước tới giờ. Chắc cô ấy vui lắm.
beats: Medium view of the sunlit embankment path and blooming pink lotus flowers swaying in the morning breeze.
@Khoi walks up the embankment to @Ngan looking healthy and bright, gesturing happily toward the blooming lotus pond.
@Ngan smiles warmly and ruffles @Khoi's hair.
clips.sfx: birds, light laughter, wind in lotus leaves

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Chiều hôm ấy, Ngân ra bến xe về thành phố. Ngoảnh lại lần cuối, cô thấy mặt đầm sen yên ả, phẳng lặng như gương.
beats: Wide slow push-in on a quiet rural roadside bus stop at the edge of the village in golden late-afternoon sunlight, the blooming lotus pond glowing behind it.
@Ngan steps up to the bus stop with her small wheeled suitcase and turns to look back over her shoulder at the peaceful pond.
@Ngan smiles faintly and turns forward toward the road.
clips.sfx: a distant bus engine approaching, cicadas, wind
clips.setting: Late afternoon: a roadside bus stop at the edge of the village, the lotus pond glowing gold behind it.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Nhưng nếu nhìn lâu hơn chút nữa, Ngân sẽ thấy ở góc đầm xa nhất, một bóng người khác đang đứng ngập trong nước.
beats: Telephoto view across the darkening pond toward its far corner under overhanging bamboo.
The camera slowly pushes in: a dark figure stands waist-deep among the leaves, motionless, face hidden in shadow.
The figure slowly turns its head toward the village.
clips.sfx: wind dying, frogs stopping abruptly, a low hum
clips.setting: Dusk: the far corner of the lotus pond, deep shadow under overhanging bamboo, mist on the water.
clips.extras: a distant dark figure standing waist-deep in the pond, face hidden in shadow (unnamed, no reference image)

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bởi năm ấy, bên bờ đầm, đâu chỉ có một nỗi oan khuất chưa lời giải. Và đầm sen làng Hạ Liên vẫn còn đang đợi.
beats: High above the lotus pond at night, mist drifting over the dark leaves.
The camera slowly pulls back and rises as the moon disappears behind clouds.
Far below, a single ring of ripples spreads across the black water in the center of the pond.
clips.sfx: a deep low drone, wind, a single distant splash
clips.setting: Night: the whole lotus pond from high above under a hazy moon, mist rising.
